tools.name: listCapabilities
tools.description: List every ScrapingBot tool, the API routes behind them and their parameters. Free.

tools.name: scrapeWebsite
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return its content as markdown (format: "html" for the raw HTML). 1 credit; render_js (pages built with JavaScript) 5; premium_proxy 10; stealth_proxy 75. screenshot: true attaches a screenshot image.

tools.name: extractStructuredData
tools.description: Fetch a web page and have AI pull out exactly the fields you want, as JSON. Pass ai_query (plain English, e.g. "title, price and stock") or ai_schema ({"field": "description"}). The page cost plus 5 credits.

tools.name: getScrapeJob
tools.description: Look up an earlier scrape by the job_id it returned. Free.

tools.name: pollJobUntilDone
tools.description: Wait for a scrape job to finish, then return it. Free.

tools.name: runBrowserScenario
tools.description: Open a page in a real browser, run steps such as click, fill, scroll and wait, then return the resulting page as markdown. js_scenario: {"instructions": [{"fill": ["#q", "shoes"]}, {"click": "#go"}, {"wait": 1000}]}. From 5 credits.

tools.name: googleSearch
tools.description: Google results as JSON: web (default), images, videos, news, shopping, places or maps (type), for any country (gl) and language (hl). Places and maps results include a cid for googleReviews. 10 credits.

tools.name: googleReviews
tools.description: Reviews of a place from Google Maps, by the cid, fid or placeId in a googleSearch places or maps result. sortBy newest, mostRelevant, highestRating or lowestRating; pass nextPageToken for more. 10 credits.

tools.name: instagramUser
tools.description: An Instagram profile: bio, follower, following and post counts, links and the numeric user id other tools need. Pass one of username, user_id or url. 5 credits.

tools.name: instagramSearch
tools.description: Search Instagram accounts, hashtags, places or posts (search_type), or everything at once (global). 5 credits.

tools.name: instagramMedia
tools.description: Instagram content by mode: an account's posts, reels or tagged posts (user_id), one post by shortcode or url, a post's comments, the replies to a comment (comment_id), or an account's active stories (username). 5 credits.

tools.name: instagramFollowers
tools.description: List or search an Instagram account's followers or following, by numeric user_id from instagramUser. query searches the whole list; max_id pages. For very large accounts Instagram shows only about 50 recent followers, so use query to find someone. 5 credits.

tools.name: tiktokVideo
tools.description: A TikTok video's stats, caption, author, sound and download links, by video URL. 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktokUser
tools.description: A TikTok profile by username: bio, counts, verified badge and numeric user id; include_posts returns the latest videos instead. 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktokSearch
tools.description: Search TikTok creators (search_type: users) or videos (videos) by keyword. 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktokComments
tools.description: Comments on a TikTok video (url), or the replies to one comment (comment_id plus the video url or video_id). 1 credit.

tools.name: tiktokFollowers
tools.description: A TikTok account's followers or the accounts it follows, by numeric user_id (data.user.id from tiktokUser). Up to 50. 1 credit.

tools.name: amazonSearch
tools.description: Search Amazon US products by keyword: title, price, rating, Prime and photo for each. page for more. 10 credits.

tools.name: amazonProduct
tools.description: Everything on an Amazon product page by ASIN: price, rating, availability, bullet points, specifications, photos and variations. 10 credits.

tools.name: amazonProducts
tools.description: Full details for up to 20 ASINs in one call, the same as amazonProduct for each. 10 credits per product returned; ASINs that fail are free.

tools.name: amazonSuggestions
tools.description: The suggestions Amazon shows as a shopper types: useful for keyword research. 10 credits.

tools.name: amazonRankings
tools.description: Amazon's Best Sellers or New Releases for a department, in rank order, with price and rating. 10 credits.

tools.name: providerRequest
tools.description: Call any Google, Instagram, TikTok or Amazon endpoint by path, for the few the other tools do not cover (listCapabilities lists them). Costs the same as that API.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrapeWebsite, extractStructuredData, instagramSearch · Public sink: instagramUser, instagramMedia · Destructive: scrapeWebsite, runBrowserScenario.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrapeWebsite, extractStructuredData, instagramSearch · Public sink: instagramUser, instagramMedia · Destructive: scrapeWebsite, runBrowserScenario

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
